title: What's New in QuickBar Pro v1.0.1
changelog:
🚀 New Features

- Event Themes: 13 themes including New Year, Christmas, Halloween, Valentine, Diwali, Cyber Monday, Easter, Summer, Ocean, Neon, Midnight
- One-click import from Storyboard to AE Timeline
- YouTube search with page scraping fallback
- Floating import button on canvas

🛠️ Improvements

- Performance: Dirty flag render loop (90% less idle CPU)
- Performance: Canvas shadows only for selected objects
- Performance: Removed backdrop-filter from non-essential elements
- Modern glass-morphism UI for downloader tab
- Better theme system with full background/border changes

🐛 Bug Fixes

- Fixed YouTube Error 153 in storyboard preview
- Fixed YouTube search HTTP 403 error
- Fixed tab-downloader CSS loading issue
- Fixed CSS syntax errors
- Removed PDF support from storyboard (images/video/audio only)

➕ Removed

- Relinker and Depth buttons removed from overview
- Flip H/V, Undo, Redo, Preview removed from graph toolbar
- YouTube video support removed from storyboard canvas
- PDF support removed from storyboard
